# Setup

Setup R env. Load packages and set default image export formats, size and resolution.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      fig.height = 8, 
                      fig.width = 12, 
                      dev = c("png", "pdf"),
                      dpi = 1000)
library(tidyverse)
options(scipen = 999) #Prevent scientific notation

input_path <- c("1-Montipora_WGS_workflow/1-Montipora_SNP_calling/3_Visualize_VCF_QC/1-Input/1-Unfiltered_VCF_stats")
output_path <- c("1-Montipora_WGS_workflow/1-Montipora_SNP_calling/3_Visualize_VCF_QC/3-Output/1-Unfiltered_VCF_stats")
```



# Variant based statistics

```{r vars, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
var_qual.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.lqual.gz")
var_ldepth.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.vcf.ldepth.gz")
var_lmiss.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.lmiss.gz")
var_freq.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.frq.gz")
ind_idepth.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.vcf.idepth.gz")
ind_imiss.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.vcf.imiss.gz")
ind_het.file <- file.path(input_path, "Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.het.gz")

var_qual.min  <- 20
var_depth.min <- 10
var_depth.max <- 60
var_lmiss.min  <- 0.25
var_freq.min  <- 0.05
```

## Variant quality
```{r var_qual, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
var_qual <-  read.table(file = var_qual.file, 
             sep = '\t', 
             header = TRUE, 
             as.is = TRUE,
             fill = TRUE)

summary(var_qual$QUAL)

var_qual.plot <- var_qual %>% 
  ggplot(aes(QUAL)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light()

var_qual.inset.plot <- var_qual %>% 
  filter(QUAL < 500) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(QUAL)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_qual.min, color = "red", linewidth=1.0)

var_qual.filt.plot <- var_qual %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20 & QUAL < 500) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(QUAL)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.inset.lqual.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_qual.inset.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.lqual.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_qual.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.filt.lqual.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_qual.filt.plot
dev.off()
```

## Variant mean depth
```{r var_depth, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
var_ldepth <-  read.table(file = var_ldepth.file, 
             sep = '\t', 
             header = TRUE, 
             as.is = TRUE,
             fill = TRUE)

summary(var_ldepth$MEAN_DEPTH)


var_ldepth.plot <- var_ldepth %>% 
  ggplot(aes(MEAN_DEPTH)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.min, color = "red", size=1.0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.max, color = "red", size=1.0); var_ldepth.plot

var_ldepth.inset.plot <- var_ldepth %>% 
  filter(MEAN_DEPTH < 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(MEAN_DEPTH)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.min, color = "red", size=1.0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.max, color = "red", size=1.0); var_ldepth.inset.plot

var_ldepth.filter.plot <- var_ldepth %>% 
  filter(MEAN_DEPTH > var_depth.min & MEAN_DEPTH < var_depth.max) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(MEAN_DEPTH)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.min, color = "red", size=1.0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_depth.max, color = "red", size=1.0); var_ldepth.filter.plot

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.inset.ldepth.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_ldepth.inset.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.ldepth.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_ldepth.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.filt.ldepth.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_ldepth.filter.plot
dev.off()
```

## Variant missingness
```{r var_miss, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
var_lmiss <- read.table(file = var_lmiss.file, 
             sep = '\t', 
             header = TRUE, 
             as.is = TRUE,
             fill = TRUE)

summary(var_lmiss$F_MISS)

var_lmiss.plot <- var_lmiss %>% 
  ggplot(aes(F_MISS)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_lmiss.min, color = "red", size=1.0); var_lmiss.plot

var_lmiss.filt.plot <- var_lmiss %>% 
  filter(F_MISS < var_lmiss.min) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(F_MISS)) +
  geom_density(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_lmiss.min, color = "red", size=1.0); var_lmiss.filt.plot

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.lmiss.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_lmiss.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.filt.lmiss.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_lmiss.filt.plot
dev.off()
```

## Minor allele frequency
```{r var_freq, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
var_freq <- read.table(file = var_freq.file, 
             sep = '\t', 
             header = FALSE, 
             as.is = TRUE,
             fill = TRUE, 
             col.names = c("CHR", "POS", "N_ALLELES", "N_CHR", "A1", "A2"))

var_freq <- filter(var_freq, CHR != "CHROM")

# find minor allele frequency
var_freq$MAF <- var_freq %>% 
  select(A1, A2) %>% 
  apply(1, function(z) min(z)) %>% 
  as.numeric()

summary(var_freq$MAF)

var_freq.plot <- var_freq %>% 
  ggplot(aes(MAF)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_freq.min, color = "red", size=1.0); var_freq.plot

var_freq.filt.plot <- var_freq %>% 
  filter(MAF > 0.05) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(MAF)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "dodgerblue1", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var_freq.min, color = "red", size=1.0); var_freq.filt.plot


pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.frq.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_freq.plot
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.filt.frq.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
var_freq.filt.plot
dev.off()
```

## Heterozygosity and inbreeding coefficient per individual
```{r ind_het, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ind_het <- read.table(file = ind_het.file, 
             sep = '\t', 
             header = TRUE, 
             as.is = TRUE,
             fill = TRUE)

ind_het.plot <- ind_het %>% 
  arrange(F) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = F)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "dodgerblue", colour = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Inbreeding coefficient F") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)); ind_het.plot

summary(ind_het$F)

pdf(file.path(output_path, "/Ulithi23_ULFMv1.pop.allsites.variant_sites.vcf.filt.het.pdf"), height = 20, width = 20)
ind_het.plot
dev.off()
```
